verdict.rationale: The only AI capability in the evidence is AI-powered detection that automatically finds signature and location/date fields in a submitted document. That is AI analysis of the user's own data, but it is narrow field placement rather than insights or recommendations. Missing for 10: any AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's documents or company data, an in-product AI assistant or recommendation surface, documentation of how detections are shown or reviewed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
